programme.title: Getaway
programme.desc: The chase is on. Academy Award nominee Ethan Hawke (Training Day) stars in this gritty, high-octane action thriller alongside actress/music sensation Selena Gomez and Oscar winner Jon Voight (Coming Home). Hawke stars as a former racecar driver, working against the clock and forced into a dangerous mission behind the wheel. Desperately trying to save the life of his kidnapped wife, he commandeers a fast car and its unwitting owner (Gomez), taking them on a high-speed race against time at the command of the unseen mysterious assailant (Voight) holding his wife hostage and watching his every move. To save his wife, he took the job. To keep her alive, he'll take control.

programme.title: North By Northwest
programme.desc: Cary Grant stars as an innocent man mistaken for a spy in one of director Alfred Hitchcock's greatest thrillers. While leaving New York's Plaza Hotel, advertising executive Roger Thornhill (Grant) has the misfortune of standing just as the name "George Kaplan" is paged--starting a lethal case of mistaken identity and a nonstop game of cat and mouse as he is pursued across North America by espionage agents trying to kill him--and by police who suspect him of murder.

programme.title: Inkheart
programme.desc: What if every time you read aloud, the story came to life? Based on Cornelia Funke's bestselling children's novel, this timeless tale of imagination and adventure centers on a young girl whose father (The Mummy's Brendan Fraser) has a secret ability to bring characters from books to life when he reads them aloud. But when a ruthless villain (The Lord of the Rings' Andy Serkis) from a rare children's fable kidnaps Meggie's father to bring others out of the boundaries of fiction, she and a disparate group of friends both real and magic embark on the kind of adventure she has only read about in books to save him and set things right. Also starring The Da Vinci Code's Paul Bettany and Oscar winners Helen Mirren and Jim Broadbent, 'Inkheart' makes all the mystery, all the danger, and all the adventure jump off the page!

programme.title: East Of Eden
programme.desc: Hollywood legend James Dean stars in this adaptation of John Steinbeck's classic novel East of Eden. Teenaged Cal Trask (Dean--Rebel Without a Cause, Giant) longs for the affection that his father reserves for his brother Aron, but his efforts meet only rejection. Also attracted to Aron's girlfriend, Cal becomes so frustrated in his search for love and acceptance that he reveals a long-held secret about their mother to Aron . . . knowledge that now tears the family apart.

programme.title: Le Pays Des Merveilles Ep.2: Ticino
programme.desc: Generally speaking, Ticino is Switzerland's sunniest region. But when the weather turns to rain Nik Hartmann refuses to be discouraged from going canyoning or taking a boat trip to the Brissago Islands. He also visits the village of Intragna, the thermal baths of Craveggia and the Alpe Sal refuge.

programme.title: Alterrenative Voyages Ep.9: Antarctic (Commandant Charcot)
programme.desc: We head for the Antarctic aboard the high polar expedition vessel operated by Ponant, "Le Commandant Charcot". We notably meet the chief engineer, Hugues Decamus, and the captain, Stanislas Devorsine.

programme.title: Le Journal De La Rtbf
programme.desc: Complete international news roundup presented by the RTBF news staff.

programme.title: Les Saisons De Pique-Assiette Ep.2: Long live legumes
programme.desc: On the menu: lentils papet vaudois style and crispy chickpeas for the aperitif. Discovery of the day: Geneva longeole cooked on the plancha. Annick Jeanmairet is once again assisted by comedian Brigitte Rosset.

programme.title: Pistes Vertes Ep.29: At the heart of the Vernier marsh
programme.desc: Exploration of the Vernier marsh, a natural area and former meander of the Seine. Discovery of agroforestry in Calvados, a farming method with many advantages. Roasting coffee beans using a solar oven is possible in Seine-Maritime. All about glasswort.

programme.title: Le Journal Afrique
programme.desc: All the African news from the TV5MONDE news staff.

programme.title: Le Journal De La Rts
programme.desc: All the news from RTS.

programme.title: Merci Professeur !
programme.desc: A short review of the French language, its quirks, accents and news.

programme.title: Le Journal De France 2

programme.title: L'Invité
programme.desc: Patrick Simonin hosts the stars in the headlines, culture, music, film, books, an unmissable rendezvous with all those who light up our times.

programme.title: Yétili Ep.41: Electrico 28
programme.desc: Nina and Léon, two little mice, live in a bookshop whose mascot is a large yeti cuddly toy called Yétili. Each evening, once the bookshop has closed, Yétili comes to life and settles his two friends on his knees ready to read them a story.

programme.title: Yétili Ep.42: The long list of Luchien's little pleasures
programme.desc: Nina and Léon, two little mice, live in a bookshop whose mascot is a large yeti cuddly toy called Yétili. Each evening, once the bookshop has closed, Yétili comes to life and settles his two friends on his knees ready to read them a story.

programme.title: Dessine Les Animaux Avec Koumi Ep.43: Draw a pelican
programme.desc: Koumi is 6 years old, mischievous and always full of fun. The dream of her life is to know all the animals of the world, and she absolutely loves drawing! In each episode she explains how to draw animals really well.

programme.title: Dessine Les Animaux Avec Koumi Ep.44: Draw a mudskipper
programme.desc: Koumi is 6 years old, mischievous and always full of fun. The dream of her life is to know all the animals of the world, and she absolutely loves drawing! In each episode she explains how to draw animals really well.

programme.title: C'Est Mathématique ! Avec Iman Ep.25: How do you locate numbers on a number line?
programme.desc: Iman, a former maths teacher, offers primary school pupils a survival kit to help them approach secondary school with confidence. In each episode, using a fun and educational approach, he aims to make his subject clear and practical.

programme.title: Jad Et Ses Soeurs Ep.3: Moroccan hospitality
programme.desc: Twin sisters Ranya and Syrine are as adorable as they are inseparable. Their lives are joyful and full of everyday adventures. But everything is about to be turned upside down with the arrival of their little brother, Jad.

programme.title: Mission Héros Ep.15: Harassment
programme.desc: At 8 years old, Amir leads the life of an everyday superhero. Thanks to his online avatar, he raises awareness among the children who watch him and throughout his neighborhood about civility and citizenship.

programme.title: Belfort & Lupin Ep.25: Major Discord
programme.desc: Belfort, the king's dog, and Lupin, the wolf of the gardens, live in the Palace of Versailles. As inseparable as they are unlikely, they come to the rescue of all their furry and feathered friends, from the royal menagerie to the local wildlife.

programme.title: Les Triplés Ep.70: Forgotten Birthday
programme.desc: The triplets may look like angels, but they're not the last to get up to mischief... The two brothers and the sister are inseparable and as loving as they are mischievous. The adults need to be brave to channel their energy!

programme.title: Potobot Ep.51: Future imperfect (part two)
programme.desc: Twelve year-old Chloé is feeling somewhat disillusioned. Then Potobot, a little robot arrives from the future with a mission for her: to change the world and make the future a better place. There's no doubt about it, working together, one step after another, the two of them can move mountains!

programme.title: Cirkus Ep.1: Roll up, roll up!
programme.desc: Aria would love to spend a wonderful summer... Her wish comes true when a circus troupe sets up camp in her village.

programme.title: Foot Go Ep.21: Relapse
programme.desc: Eight year-old Tata arrives in a new school. She wants to join its football team but isn't allowed to; after all she's a girl! Refusing to be beaten, Tata decides to set up her own girls' team with the help of her gang of friends.

programme.title: Les Super-Pouvoirs Du Vivant Ep.1: The bombardier beetle
programme.desc: The animal kingdom is brimming with creatures that have extraordinary powers. To reveal the incredible inventiveness of nature and the importance of protecting it, each episode takes us on a fascinating journey rich in poetry and humour.

programme.title: Matière Grise
programme.desc: The magazine programme which takes the mystery out of science, encouraging us to think... without all the brain work!

programme.title: Dans La Bulle De... Ep.9: Frédéric François
programme.desc: A timeless artist takes on the game of the five senses. Frédéric François has been singing about love, in French, for more than fifty-five years! We know him well as an exception in the musical landscape, but what more can this experiment reveal about his personality?

programme.title: Secrets Des Profondeurs Ep.6: The Sorel ship graveyard
programme.desc: Sam and Mario visit the Sorel Islands to reveal what is probably one of Canada's largest ship graveyards.

programme.title: Le Beau Vélo De Ravel
programme.desc: A bike journey along the entire RAVeL network, an independent cycle path network in Wallonia. With each programme, the presenter tells us of a stage in his journey and talks about mobility and tourist resources in the region.

programme.title: La Belle Vie Ep.6: Life as the wind blows
programme.desc: Julien meets Joanie and Hugues, two former members of the armed forces, just a few days be-fore they set sail for the southern seas. Aboard their catamaran, they plan to spend five years seeking out the finest kitesurfing spots around the globe.

programme.title: Au Bonheur Des Livres
programme.desc: Around a chosen theme, Claire Chazal welcomes two authors: novelists, biographers, essayists or historians, and shares viewers' literary favorites.

programme.title: Rassemblance Ep.19: Livia Stoianova and Yassen Samouilov (Bulgaria)
programme.desc: They are behind the fashion house On aura tout vu, based in Paris since 1998. Livia Stoianova and Yassen Samouilov blend fashion, art and performance, exploring excess, diversion and visual poetry. Their unexpected creations, nourished by their Bulgarian heritage and migratory journey, have seduced Beyoncé and Lady Gaga.

programme.title: Le Match Dans Le Match Ep.101: Arnaud Alessandria
programme.desc: He finished 13th in the alpine combined at the 2022 Beijing Olympic Games, where he was also the flag bearer for the Monegasque delegation: skier Arnaud Alessandria is Sébastien Serrano's guest.

programme.title: Le Téléjournal De Radio-Canada
programme.desc: The televised news programme from the Radio-Canada team.

programme.title: Les Routes Du Goût Ep.5: Emma and Alfonso's walk (1/2)
programme.desc: An intimate and gourmet meeting in the heart of Campania. Michelin-starred chef Alfonso Iaccarino opens the doors of Don Alfonso 1890, a temple of Mediterranean cuisine, where a family tradition spanning five generations continues. An opportunity to taste cuisine deeply rooted in terroir.

programme.title: Château ! Ep.20: Château-Gaillard - Fougères-sur-Bièvre
programme.desc: At the royal estate of Château-Gaillard, a very special plum was born: the "Reine-Claude", named in honor of King Francis I's wife. The Château of Fougères-sur-Bièvre is an outlier - a blend of medieval and Renaissance architecture. Built in the 15th century by Pierre de Refuge, it was a symbol of power.

programme.title: La Fièvre Des Festivals Ep.6: Celebrations
programme.desc: For organizers, after long weeks of work and tension, the end of a festival is always an emotional time. It's also an opportunity to offer one last moment of joy to the audience and to celebrate the event as a team, before gathering again for a new edition.

programme.title: Alterrenative Voyages Ep.10: Tunisia
programme.desc: We head to the town of Tozeur to lift the mystery on its architecture. And, in the mountainous region of Dahar, we meet Mohamed Sadok, chairman of the authentic tourism federation Destination Dahar, which supports environmentally conscious and alternative projects.

programme.title: Tendance Xxi Ep.31: The Lenôtre school/FONT&ROMANI
programme.desc: The Lenôtre cookery school, passing on the passion for the culinary arts that drove its founder, the illustrious Gaston Lenôtre. A footwear institution that bears the name of a London district: the Chelsea boot. FONT&ROMANI or the art of high-end rug-making using the Savonnerie technique. The elegance of draping.

programme.title: L'Épicerie
programme.desc: The place to be for all those who are interested in what they put on their plates and all things relating to food. The programme: reports, surveys, taste tests, test benches, answers to questions from television viewers, including advice and simple but effective tricks.

programme.title: Questions Pour Un Champion
programme.desc: A general knowledge quiz.

programme.title: À Boire Et À Manger Ep.10: Kamouraska
programme.desc: In Kamouraska, Lindsay combines to perfection the rich flavour of Haiti with that of the Lower Saint-Lawrence, to the total delight of her co-presenters. Today, actors and friends Ève Landry and Mélissa Bédard join them around the table.

programme.title: Le Journal De France 2
programme.desc: The television news programme of the France 2 editorial board (1 p.m. edition, Paris time).

programme.title: Les Victoires Du Jazz 2025
programme.desc: 23rd edition of Les Victoires du Jazz! A ceremony, under the honorary presidency of Angélique Kidjo, during which six Victoires were awarded, recognising the instrumental artist, vocal artist, breakthrough artist, album, concert and world music album of the year. The opportunity to savour fantastic performances!

programme.title: La Faune Connectée Ep.3: Mysteries below the ice, winter at Opinicon Lake
programme.desc: Each winter, Northern map turtles hibernate under the ice on Opinicon Lake, with no access to air. In the face of climate warming and sound pollution, they have become essential allies for biologists, helped by recent technologies to study how they adapt.

programme.title: Les Secrets Du Finistère
programme.desc: Having returned to her native Brittany, Police Captain Morgane Ledantec is faced with the discovery of human bones after a sacred oak tree is felled by a storm. The victim was a Druid. Morgane needs to renew her contacts with childhood friends, who all seem to have something to hide.

programme.title: Alterrenative Voyages Ep.11: France (Brignoles)
programme.desc: We're off to Brignoles in the Var to meet Corinne Lafortune, Circular Economy Project Coordinator at Ecoscience Provence. The association's primary objective is to reduce waste! We also visited the Bulles de Coco eco-friendly soap factory and the La Courtoisie recycling centre.

programme.title: Le Choix Du Pianiste
programme.desc: François Touraine has become a virtuoso pianist thanks to his teacher Rachel, with whom he has fallen in love. As the Second World War breaks out, he must make a choice: Rachel is Jewish. In an attempt to save her, he goes to perform in Germany.
